summary.name: Translucent Tissue-Paper Collage. Printmaking and Craft Materials category, extracted in the 2026-10-12 repository sync.
summary.visualIdentity: Overlapping translucent fibers, torn edges and colored tissue layers build underwater depth. Light must transmit through overlaps, and pieces must never read as opaque cardstock.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: underwater tissue scenes with fish, kelp and light shafts, given as authored examples. Inferred: other layered, depth-driven scenes. Audience and objective are unspecified.
summary.limitations: The palette is limited to supplied tokens unless approved tissue colors exist, and that gap must be reported. The two-color contrast check ignores textures, transmitted light and animated backgrounds. No motion references are selected.
summary.palette: Background is scene_dependent: #172D3A is an authored deep blue-green underwater fallback, not an exact source color. #F2EEE1 is the foreground, reaching 12.284:1 for opaque captions only. Gradients are disabled.
summary.motionAndInteraction: GSAP drives a paused, seekable timeline for per-piece sway, depth-scaled drift parallax and layer laydown, and every frame is redrawn. Keep sharp cuts and reading holds. No interaction behavior is specified.
summary.audio: Not mandated by the style. Music, voiceover, effects, ambience or silence may suit the unspecified topic and audience; honor any explicit user audio. Do not silently default to instrumental music.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploads are required. Tissue shapes are authored polygons with seeded torn edges and fiber textures generated locally. Fonts and assets must load before rendering; chroma-js and @remotion/noise are optional.
summary.combinations: style-101 (restrained layer depth) is the only suggested secondary. Keep style-124 dominant, do not import its palette, avoid competing full-scene treatments, and offer reduced motion in HTML.
summary.productionApproach: Canvas 2D renders visuals; GSAP owns motion; HyperFrames handles assembly and export. Remotion is fallback only if HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limit is recorded. Validate with check, snapshot and render.
